Check if test infrastructure is present and refers to the current package

Source: R/check_test_infra.R
check_test_infra.Rd

Check if test infrastructure is present and refers to the current package

Usage

check_test_infra(
  path_infra = fs::path_wd("tests", "tinytest.R"),
  signal = c("error", "warning", "message", "quiet")
)

Arguments

path_infra

character string with a path to the file which determines the test infrastructure, see Details.

signal

character string indicating the type of signal to be used: "error" to throw an error, "warning" to issue a warning, "message" to show a message, or "quiet" to be quiet.

Value

A character vector containing a character string with the text of the signal, which is "" if no signal is emitted.

Details

The default path_infra points to file tinytest.R in directory tests of the current working directory, which belongs to the test infrastructure of tinytest. To use the test infrastructure of testthat, use path_infra = fs::path_wd("tests", "testthat.R").

The signal indicated by argument signal is emitted:

  • if the package indicated in path_infra is not among the dependencies

  • if the file that determines the used testing infrastructure does not exist

  • if the file that determines the used testing infrastructure does not refer to the package in the current working directory
